source.label: ReforesTree mapping/final_dataset.csv (inside reforesTree.zip, Zenodo 6813783)
source.method: lon/lat of each of the 4663 mapped tree bounding boxes (lon_d, lat_d) across 6 drone-surveyed sites, read from the CSV via HTTP range requests into the zip

note: Each point is one annotated tree; the six sites are small (~0.1 km2) agroforestry plots in Los Rios / Guayas, Ecuador, so points cluster into six tight groups.
